summary: Bentleys Victoria is the Hawthorn-based Victorian member of the Bentleys network, rebranded from McLean Delmo Bentleys in July 2025 and led by CEO Jack Delmo, who also runs M&A and growth. It is an 80+ person firm hiring accountants in Hawthorn working in Xero and MYOB. Jack's public activity is about tax reform, succession and M&A rather than technology.

hooks.text: Active hiring of a Senior Accountant and Accounting Manager in Hawthorn, with a Senior Accountant role built around processing client documents and journals in Xero and MYOB: reconciliation load is a capacity issue.
Jack leads M&A and growth and the firm has added regional offices; absorbing new practices and offices makes a consistent reconciliation process valuable.
Jack's recent public focus is tax reform and succession planning, so an efficiency pitch should be framed around partner and manager capacity rather than technology.

risks.text: Jack Delmo has no email on file, so outreach goes to Partner/Director Fahmid Ahmed; Jack may be best reached via LinkedIn or a warm intro.
Part of a national network of independent member firms; another member firm (Bentleys Queensland) already uses XBert, so tooling may be influenced network-wide.
Audit and advisory-led, large firm (80+ staff); weak-to-moderate fit per account notes.
